description.value: A secondary fMRI analysis examined whether DRD4 VNTR and OPRM1 A118G genotypes modulate BOLD responses to alcohol taste cues before and after an alcohol priming dose.

spans.text: The present study is a secondary analysis of the possible genetic moderators of the mesocorticolimbic response to alcohol tastes
